ov: Small reef fish of the warm Indo-Pacific, usually with white bars on an orange, red, yellow, brown or black body. They shelter among the stinging tentacles of sea anemones and in return defend, clean and fan the anemone. Finding Nemo made them famous.

why.p: Popular in the aquarium trade, and easily bred in captivity; the ocellaris is among the most traded marine fish.

rg: Warm and tropical waters of the Indian and Pacific oceans.
fx: Groups have a strict size order: the female is largest, then the breeding male, then the non-breeders.
Young clownfish drift in the open ocean as larvae, then settle on the bottom and search for an anemone to live in.
